prompt.project_info: A warm cinematic street-fashion portrait that contrasts muted earth-tone streetwear with an uninterrupted cyan-blue sky.
prompt.main_subject: An adult man with short curly dark hair and a calm, introspective expression directed toward the camera. He wears an oversized muted rust-colored hoodie, wide beige corduroy pants, striped socks, and clean white sneakers in matte textures that softly absorb sunlight.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical low-angle, mid-distance outdoor portrait. The subject sits casually on the edge of a textured concrete structure, hands resting at his sides, legs extended, and one foot slightly raised. A vast uninterrupted soft cyan-blue sky (#8ec9e8) forms the clean minimalist backdrop; the concrete adds subtle grain and visual weight. Exclude text, logos, and watermarks.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour warm natural daylight around 6200K casts soft highlights across the face and clothing and a long crisp shadow on the wall below. Blend warm earth tones with bright atmospheric blue for a serene, youthful editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm full-frame lens simulation at f/2.8, vertical 2:3 crop, slightly low angle, moderate depth of field, sharp subject detail with gentle natural falloff into the sky, ultra-realistic matte fabric and concrete textures.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic outdoor portrait captured in warm natural daylight, with the subject seated casually on the edge of a textured concrete structure. The framing is slightly low-angled and mid-distance, placing the subject against a vast, uninterrupted sky in soft cyan-blue (#8ec9e8), creating a clean, minimalist backdrop. Lighting is golden-hour warm (6200K), casting soft highlights across the face and clothing while producing a long, crisp shadow on the wall below. The pose is relaxed and editorial: hands resting at the sides, legs extended with one foot slightly raised, and a calm, introspective facial expression directed toward the camera. Wardrobe features oversized casual streetwear: muted rust-colored hoodie, wide beige corduroy pants, striped socks, and clean white sneakers, styled in matte textures that absorb the sunlight softly. The concrete surface adds subtle grain and visual weight, contrasting with the airy sky. Lens simulation approximates a 50mm full-frame at f/2.8, providing moderate depth of field with sharp detail on the subject and gentle natural falloff into the sky. The color palette blends warm earth tones with bright atmospheric blues, creating a serene, youthful, and editorial mood. Editorial, modern, high-detail, cinematic composition, ultra-realistic textures, professional fashion photography style.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required for this template. If a replacement person, wardrobe, or location reference is attached, preserve the approved adult identity, rust hoodie, beige corduroy silhouette, weathered concrete ledge, low-angle framing, cyan sky, and long sun-cast shadow; any of those elements may otherwise be replaced while retaining the composition and warm/cool palette contrast.
